<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex06012025-05-1313-27-37" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon" part="F">
      <milestone n="Colophon" unit="section"/>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4478"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3727">byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa</rs>'i tshig dang don gsal par bshad pa</rs> ×× <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">shag skya'i <choice><corr>dge</corr><sic>ged → ‹d›ged</sic></choice><note type="editorial">The faulty reading "ged" was corrected to "dge" in the manuscript by the addition of a "d"-prefix, but the final "d" was note deleted</note> slong byang chub grags</rs> kyis sbyar pa ||×|| × rdzogs so ||
         <note type="translation">Clear explanation of the words and meaning of the Bodhi(sattva)caryāvatāra composed by the Śākya monk Byang chub grags. It is completed.</note>
